messages:
Linda (Product): quick sync — i'm sketching the auto-fallback preview UI. main asks: explainability text for why a fallback happened, an audit-friendly decision trace export, and configurable telemetry sampling. who wants to weigh in?
Omar (Platform): +1. we should make sampling deterministic per-tenant (hash request id) so audits can re-run slices. also need a precedence rule for dedicated vs hosted routes.
Kevin (Eng): agree on deterministic sampling. also the preview should show the decision path (rule hit order) and the concrete signals that triggered it (status codes, latency, quota breaches). one-liner explanation for the product UI.
Sara (Security): audit export must include a signed decision trace id, model_version, quantization flags, and region. retention policy needs to be explicit — ops/legal will want 90/365 day options.
Aditya (Data): telemetry sampling: stratify by error class + tenant size. baseline 1% global, but bump to 10% for anomalous spikes. include a small representative request payload (hashed) for repro without leaking PII.
Marie (UX): for the UI, propose a compact tree: Top: policy name + rule highlight. Below: "Why this happened" one-sentence and an expandable trace with raw signals. Add an "export trace" button (CSV/JSON) for audits.
Kevin (Eng): quick config POC for discussion:
```yaml
auto_fallback:
  enabled: true
  sampling: 0.01   # default global
  stratify_by: [error_class, tenant_tier]
  precedence: enforce  # enforce|allow-offload
  export_retention_days: 90
```
Linda (Product): nice. note on "precedence": we need clear semantics when tenant is on Dedicated — fallback may degrade in-place but must not overflow to hosted unless customer opts into cross-tier fallback.
Omar (Platform): yep. add a boolean `allow_cross_tier` default false. fallback router must consult tenant metadata.
Kevin (Eng): will add `allow_cross_tier: false` to the schema. also adding `explain_level: brief|detailed` so console can toggle verbosity.
Sara (Security): please ensure exported traces include a verification hash and an ACL field for who downloaded it. for legal we might need an audit log entry per export action.
opsbot (CI): deploy-preview created for branch `feature/fallback-preview` — https://ci.internal/review/5234 :rocket:
Aditya (Data): for sampling weights i'll draft a proposal: default weights by error_class, overrideable per-tenant. will also include a replay-mode that replays sampled traces to a sandbox.
Marie (UX): mock screens incoming — include a privacy modal explaining hashed payloads and retention.
Linda (Product): action items: Kevin -> proto + API contract update, Aditya -> sampling draft, Marie -> UI mock, Omar -> router precedence check, Sara -> export & retention spec. can we get rough ETA?
Kevin (Eng): proto + tests next sprint, PR by Thu.
Omar (Platform): i'll add contract notes and a small integration test.
Aditya (Data): sampling draft EOD Friday.
Marie (UX): mock by next Tue.
Sara (Security): i'll circulate retention options to legal today.
Linda (Product): awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Design sync for auto-fallback preview: deterministic sampling, audit export, UI explainability, precedence for dedicated routing, config proto and action items.
